roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Forward Deployed - US

bullets: Partner closely with Sales, Business Development, and customers to identify emerging opportunities. Understand the user’s problem, the buyer’s priorities, and where Certify’s data…
Develop a clear point of view on which opportunities to pursue. Test willingness to pay, market demand, pricing, cost to serve, and the potential to expand beyond the first…
Define what must be learned before increasing investment. Make thoughtful decisions about which ideas to iterate, scale, or stop, and communicate the reasoning clearly.
Partner with existing product teams where this creates leverage and accelerates the business
You thrive not only on building products, but businesses
Lead trade offs in investment that lead to accelerating revenue and delighted, profitable customers
Be accountable for product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Certify’s Applications portfolio, including Applied AI, Credentialing, Monitoring, and Provider Tools.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to translate strategy into high-quality execution.
